column1: # Hand-adjudicated samples for the four detectors #1001 names as its precondition.

# numbers belong to the tree named in each batch header, so score against that tree or the
# matching is nonsense; the script says so rather than reporting a small number quietly.
# Batches are never pooled. Each answers a question about one detector on one tree.

# on any later tree the scorer reported FALSE-POSITIVE RATE 20/20 = 100.0% and RECALL LOST for both
# rows, which by this script's own docstring means the detector regressed. It did not: the code did.
# A batch keyed `working` silently stops being a measurement of anything the moment the tree moves,
# and the sibling batch below was already pinned to a commit for exactly this reason.

column4: Extrema_ExtElC(gp_Lin, gp_Elips) takes no tolerance. Removed.
both halves reach OCCT through GeomAPI_ProjectPointOnCurve, whose windowed constructor takes no tolerance. Removed.
Bisector_BisecPC::Perform is (Cu, P, Side, DistMax) and has no origin; the signature was copied from the CC sibling. Replaced with DistMax, which is live.
neither BRepMAT2d_Explorer::Perform nor BisectingLocus::Compute takes a tolerance. Removed.
buildTrsf2D reads p1-p4 and no gp_Trsf2d setter it reaches takes a fifth. Every Swift call site passed a literal 0. Removed.
Geom2dConvert::CurveToBSplineCurve takes no tolerance; the conversion is exact, while Swift documented tolerance: Double = 1e-6.
ShapeAnalysis_Wire::CheckOuterBound takes a bool, not a precision, and the bridge never called it at all.
requesting .perspective silently returned orthographic; HLRAlgo_Projector's focal-point overload was never reached.
same defect on the polyhedral HLR path.
Draft_EdgeInfo::SetTangent is never called; the direction is discarded and NewGeometry() is trivially true. Deleted by #1000.
the body calls solver.Solve2(2, 1); NLPlate_NLPlate::Solve2 has no iteration parameter.
same.
the builder's degree and segment settings were hardcoded past. Function deleted by #1015.
